CustomField.description: Consecutive failures that trip an agent's circuit breaker from Closed to Open and block the agent. A success clears the count. Outcomes come from Log Agent Action (Success or Failure), the Governed Proxy, and /report with success; those reported while the breaker is Open are ignored. The framework records none for a deactivated agent or while governance is off.
CustomField.label: Circuit Breaker Failure Threshold
